mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{beginUtc} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_order_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN created_at >= #{beginUtc} AND status IN ('in_service', 'completed') THEN lawyer_income_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS today_income_cents, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('in_service', 'completed') THEN lawyer_income_cents ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_income_cents, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'paid' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pending_accept_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'in_service' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS in_service_count FROM orders WHERE lawyer_id = #{lawyerId} AND deleted_at IS NULL
